content:
Carla M: Heads-up — planning bring-up for new model `mistral-2025v1`. Need a short perf + quantization intake and a prioritized bench plan. Target: throughput/latency matrix, ctx-length sweep, and a small quality eval.

Ravi P: I can run the first smoke runs on dev-dedicated (4xA40). Which quant configs do we want? fp16, int8, int4?

Carla M: Yes: baseline fp16, int8, int4. Matrix: batch sizes [1,2,4,8,16], ctx [128,512,1024,2048]. Start with a smoke on bs=1 ctx=128 for each quant. If int4 OOMs, fallback to 2-GPU sharded.

Jules K: I already prepared a ~200-prompt eval set: /evals/mistral-2025/seed200.json. Includes summarization + instruction-following checks.

Perf-bench-bot: Queued run run_id=pb-1768456123-1 for bs=1 ctx=128 quant=int8 on pool dev-dedicated. ETA ~15m.

Marcus L: Note: int4 + ctx=2048 will likely exceed single-GPU memory unless we enable KV offload or tensor-slicing. Add a guard in the bench harness to skip configs that exceed estimated mem.

Carla M: Checklist (short):
- [ ] smoke runs (bs=1 ctx=128) for fp16/int8/int4
- [ ] full sweep (bs x ctx) for approved quants
- [ ] cold-start p95 (first-request after scale-to-zero)
- [ ] throughput (tokens/s) and cost tokens/s estimates
- [ ] small quality eval + delta vs fp16
- [ ] upload CSV + graphs, update onboarding doc with rollback rules

Ravi P: Running smoke now. Command I used: 
```
./bench_tool --model mistral-2025v1 --quant int8 --bs 1 --ctx 128 --measure p50,p95,throughput --repeat 3 --out run_pb1.json
```

Ravi P: paste of the smoke output: 
```
run_id: pb-1768456123-1
model: mistral-2025v1@int8
bs=1 ctx=128 p50=45ms p95=92ms tokens_per_sec=220
bs=8 ctx=512 p50=90ms p95=180ms tokens_per_sec=1320
mem_peak=7.8GB
env=dev-dedicated-4xA40
```

Carla M: nice. @Jules K can you run the seed200 quality eval for int8 vs fp16 and paste the top-level metrics? We care rougeL / exact-match / avg length and any weird tokenization regressions.

Jules K: Running now. Will post numbers when done.

Perf-bench-bot: run pb-1768456123-2 started: fp16 bs=1 ctx=128.

<Jules K later>: Summary eval results (quick): 
```
fp16: rougeL=0.743 avg_len=86.3 acc_exact=62.1
int8: rougeL=0.734 avg_len=85.9 acc_exact=61.8 delta_rouge=-1.2%
int4: rougeL=0.684 avg_len=82.1 acc_exact=57.3 delta_rouge=-8.0%  <-- significant drop
notes: int4 occasionally truncates long outputs; tokenizer alignment seems ok.
```

Marcus L: Flagging int4 quality drop. Could be quantization calibration issue or per-layer clipping. Suggest try:
- per-channel quant calibration
- outlier-aware clipping (top-k per-tensor)
- hybrid int4: quantize MLP only or attention only as an experiment

Carla M: Decision for now: promote int8 as candidate for Dedicated; hold int4 experiments in backlog and mark as experimental. We'll proceed with full int8 sweep.

Ravi P: I'll run the full int8 sweep tomorrow across bs [1,2,4,8,16] and ctx [128,512,1024]. Estimated 6-8 hours. I'll upload CSV to s3://redwood-bench/mistral-2025/1768456123_int8_sweep.csv

Ben R: Add Canary rollout plan to onboarding doc: start with 2% traffic on Dedicated, monitor p95 and error-rate, step to 25% if stable, auto rollback if p95 increases >20% or quality regression >3% on eval probes.

Carla M: Action items:
- Ravi: full int8 sweep + CSV upload (owner)
- Jules: full quality report (rouge/acc/qual examples) and diff vs fp16 (owner)
- Marcus: quick int4 calibration recipe ticket (owner)
- Ben: add canary config to onboarding doc and runtime policy (owner)

QA-bot: Test plan acknowledged. Will run automated smoke via /smoke endpoint after upload.

Ravi P: started full sweep run_id=pb-1768456123-10. Progress: bs1 done, bs2 running. Posting interim graph when done.

Carla M: thanks. let's keep this thread for updates only. If you hit an infra blocker ping #eng-infra. :thumbsup:

Jules K: quick note — include a small set of adversarial prompts in the eval (format-robustness + long-context consistency). Found a couple of context-window-drop issues at ctx>1024 in earlier models.

Marcus L: added a memory-estimator check to bench harness: it will skip configs where estimated_mem > gpu_mem_limit - 1GB. Should reduce OOM noise.

Ravi P: ++ noted. will re-run any skipped configs on 2-GPU sharded nodes.

Carla M: closing loop: once csv + eval are uploaded I'll draft the onboarding PR with performance table, recommended quant (int8), and rollback/canary settings. :white_check_mark:
